how_given: In the Claude Code chat on 2026-10-16, answering finding #79 (on the deployed v0.5.2, B06-like and B08-like presentations with no red flag ticked got self-care in 2 of 3 runs each): "for 2, choose your default suggestion", then "complete all 5 steps perfectly. i will review after you complete all 5 steps perfectly".

decision.name: red-flag screen of the patient's own words
decision.when: local mode, after the review and before any guidance is generated
decision.what: the local model reads the concern and every answer and returns only the IDs of approved red flags (RF01-RF19) the words describe as present now
decision.on_match: no guidance is generated; the case goes to urgent help as if the box had been ticked (highest matched level, approved A15 message)
decision.on_failure: fails closed: no guidance, limited state with retry

review_timing: The reviewer chose to review after release: the screen can only route more cases to urgent help (never add self-care advice), and it is released only if it misses no red flag on the labeled set; false alarms are put to the reviewer.
